Ränteintäkt från koncernföretag: Interest income from a group company
Räntekostnad till koncernföretag: Interest expense to a group company
Beslutad utdelning till koncernföretag: Dividend decided to a group company
The account is not in the chart of accounts.
Ett koncernföretag är en juridisk person: A group company is a legal person. Enter its organisation number, not a personal identity number.
Det är företagets eget organisationsnumm: That is the company's own organisation number. Enter the other group company's.
:name är markerat som koncernföretag med: :name is marked as a group company with organisation number :number. Choose Update group tags to tag the rows.
Markeringen är borttagen. Raderna den ga: The marking is removed. The tags it gave are removed when you update the group tags.
Koncernmarkeringarna är uppdaterade. Nya: The group tags are updated. New: :added, changed: :changed, removed: :removed.
Klart. Markerade rader: :tagged. Rader s: Done. Rows tagged: :tagged. Rows that already had a tag and were not changed: :skipped.
The row is now tagged as :kind.
Markeringen är borttagen från raden. Ver: The tag is removed from the row. The voucher is unchanged.
Koncernföretag bland kunder och leverant: Group companies among customers and suppliers
En kund eller leverantör som är ett anna: A customer or supplier that is another company in the same group. The other company is given by its organisation number.
Markera de kunder och leverantörer som i: Mark the customers and suppliers that belong to the same group as the company. NONOX can then tag the rows on their invoices and payments.
Företaget äger andelar i de här bolagen,: The company holds shares in these companies, and they are in the customer or supplier register.
Sök på namn, nummer eller organisationsn: Search by name, number or organisation number
Markerar raderna på fakturor, betalninga: Tags the rows of invoices, payments and supplier invoices to and from the marked customers and suppliers: receivables and sales, payables and purchases, interest. VAT, bank and exchange differences are not tagged. Rows you tagged yourself are not changed.
Allt är redan uppdaterat. Ingen rad behö: Everything is up to date. No row needs to change.
Rader med en markering som du har satt s: Rows with a tag you set yourself, which are left as they are: :kept.
För verifikationer du bokför själv, som: For vouchers you post yourself, such as loans, interest, dividends and group contributions: every posted row on the account in the period gets the same group company and kind. Rows that already have a tag keep it.
Bokförda rader på kontot under perioden:: Posted rows on the account in the period: :rows, of which :tagged already have a tag.
Ta bort markeringarna i urvalet: Remove the tags in the selection
När raderna är markerade syns här summor: Once rows are tagged, the totals per group company and kind are shown here. They are used when the group's figures are put together.
No tagged rows in the selection.
Markeringarna är en klassificering bredv: The tags are a classification beside the books, not part of them. The vouchers, the numbering and the ledger check are not affected, and every change is written to the audit trail.
Markera kunder och leverantörer som är k: Mark customers and suppliers that are group companies, and which posted rows are balances within the group. The tags sit beside the books and never change a voucher.
Kontot är ett bank- eller kassakonto. Så: The account is a bank or cash account. Such rows are rarely a balance within the group in themselves; check that you chose the right account.
Kontot är ett momskonto. Moms är ett mel: The account is a VAT account. VAT is a balance with the Swedish Tax Agency, not with the group company; check that you chose the right account.
Kontot gäller kursdifferenser. De är säl: The account is for exchange differences. They are rarely a balance within the group in themselves; check that you chose the right account.
Koncernmarkeringarna är uppdaterade, men: The group tags are updated, but the outcome differs from what was shown because the books or the markings changed in the meantime. New: :added, changed: :changed, removed: :removed.
Markeringen av :name tas bort. Raderna d: The marking of :name is removed. The rows it tagged lose their tag the next time you update the group tags. Rows you tagged yourself are not changed.
Av raderna som ändras ligger :closed i e: Of the rows that change, :closed are in a closed fiscal year and :locked in a locked period. Tags are not bookkeeping and may change there, but the change shows in the audit trail.
Av raderna ligger :closed i ett stängt r: Of the rows, :closed are in a closed fiscal year and :locked in a locked period. Tags are not bookkeeping and may change there, but the change shows in the audit trail.
Markeringen tas bort från :count rader i: The tag is removed from :count rows in the selection, including those you set yourself. The vouchers do not change.
Raden förlorar sin markering, även om du: The row loses its tag, even if you set it yourself. The voucher does not change.
